title: Student Survey Advisory Group Member
bio: Dea Kamberi is a first year at Harvard hoping to study Government and Economics. She is an Albanian-American born and raised in Worcester, Massachusetts, who now lives in Lionel Hall. Dea enjoys dancing, making tea, traveling, drawing, and playing piano. This is her very first year with the Student Survey Advisory Group, and is excited to help ensure that Harvard students get their opinions heard through surveys! She is also a member of Harvard Model Congress, a teacher for the CIVICS program, a dancer for AADT, a Learning Lab Undergraduate Fellow at the Derek Bok Center for Teaching and Learning, and a photographer & publisher for the Harvard Political Review.
